purpose: Bound the metadata-only manual-review workload for the frozen 1,278-item provisional candidate set without selecting candidates by title, diff size, or observed task suitability.
hypothesis: A deterministic sample of 12 provisional candidates per repository is sufficient to identify whether the fresh post-proxy pool contains source-level tasks worth deeper independent qualification, while preserving repository diversity.

selection.method: For each repository, sort provisional rows by SHA-256 of the UTF-8 bytes of '{seed}|{repository}#{pull_request_number}' and take the first N.
selection.underfilled_repository_rule: Take all available provisional rows for that repository; do not transfer the unused sample slots to another repository.

limitations: The deterministic sample is for metadata review only and is not a probability sample for capability estimates.
Candidate source dates are after the model training-completion proxy but public-source pretraining exposure remains unknown.
The sample cannot establish test executability, source-level baseline failure, known-fix success, grader independence, family distinctness, license suitability, or Development eligibility.
